adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the `sendAddGuestsEmails` call is wrapped in `try/catch`, and the catch block only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` without logging/propagating `err` (no message/stack). The handler then still returns success (`return { message: "Guests added" }`) and the UI shows a success toast on mutation success, so email delivery failures are effectively silent and hard to diagnose. This is a concrete, diff-grounded observability/UX issue, but not necessarily a functional defect since guests are still added and calendar attendees are updated before the email attempt.
